spans.s: गोशर्य गोशर्य, अस्, m., N. of a man.

गोशे गोशे, ind. a word belonging to one
of the provincial dialects, according to some also a
Sanskrit word; perhaps = गोसे (loc. of गोस), at
day-break.

गोषक गोषक, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist
author.

गोष्ट् गोष्ट्, cl. 1. A. गोष्टते, to assem-
ble, to collect, to heap together; (pro-
bably a nom. fr. गोष्ठ and more correctly spelt
गोष्ठ्.)
गोष्ठ गो-ष्ठ. See under गो, p. 299.

गोस गोस, अस्, m. gum myrrh, myrrh,
= गोप-रस; the last watch of the night, early
morning or day-break, = गो-सर्ग; [cf. गोशे.]

गोसगृह गोस-गृह, अम्, n. (?) the inner
part of a house, an inner or sleeping-room, a bed-
chamber.

गोसशश गोसशश, अस्, m. myrrh, = गोप-
रस; [cf. also गोस and शश.]
गोसिल गोसिल, अस्, m., N. of a man.

गोस्वलु गोस्वलु, उस्, m., N. of a pupil of
Śākalya; [cf. गुहलु and गोसिल.]
